comparison.objective: Reorient and store a nailer without pointing it at a coworker or touching its trigger; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires safe whole-tool reorientation and possibly a handoff. Candidate requires precision key engagement, collar rotation, locking and guarded cycle control.
comparison.success_condition: Record enforces pointing and trigger exclusion zones plus final case pose. Candidate enforces dynamic stopping and lock retention, with some numeric limits missing.
comparison.reason: Hazard-aware transport and orientation are unrelated to commissioning a mechanical energy absorber.
